items.title: Klopp wins first game as Germany coach, without 'top dogs'
items.description: It may have taken a little longer than he would have liked, but Jürgen Klopp has finally won a game as Germany coach. Despite a number of debutants, it was a familiar face who stood out in the victory over Serbia.

items.title: Is US President Donald Trump right to rename AI as 'Super Intelligence'?
items.description: Donald Trump thinks the name artificial intelligence sounds "fake" and has ordered US agencies to use "Super Intelligence" instead. Yet, tech firms and researchers have little reason to play along.

items.title: Paraguay, a tax and political haven for Brazil's far right
items.description: Over the past five years, applications for residence permits submitted by Brazilians in Paraguay have more than doubled. Many of them are Bolsonaro supporters who are afraid October's presidential election will be won by incumbent leader Lula – whom they accuse of plunging the Latin American giant into an unprecedented economic crisis. FRANCE 24's Fanny Lothaire, Valeria Saccone and Mélanie Blondeau report, with Jan Onoszko.

items.title: Inquiry hears 'blue code of silence' stops DV victims reporting police
items.description: Victim-survivors of police officers are concerned they will not be believed or treated seriously because of the "interconnected relationships" that police have with each other, a Tasmanian inquiry hears.

items.title: G20: Russia criticises US and warns of trade order disintegration
items.description: Speaking during a two-day gathering of G20 trade ministers, Russian Minister of Economic Development Maxim Reshetnikov said the rules of global trade were being "dismantled" while the new ones remain "unclear".

items.title: Man charged after toy poodle suffers broken jaw in alleged attack

items.title: Sea off Thai island turns green
items.description: The water off Thailand's Ko Lan island has turned a vibrant shade of green thanks to a plankton bloom.

items.title: France school protests 'rapidly becoming out of control'
items.description: French high school students lit fires outside schools and faced off with police on Friday as a protest movement that has forced the closure or disrupted education at more than 560 establishments showed no sign of abating. France 24’s Rochelle Ferguson Bouyahi takes a look at why the students are protesting, and how the demonstrations spiraled into violence.

items.title: Brazil: Who is presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro?
items.description: He was still relatively unknown in Brazil just a few months ago. The 45-year-old senator is now neck and neck with incumbent President Lula in the polls for the upcoming presidential election. Flavio Bolsonaro's victory would add Brazil to the long list of Latin American countries that have shifted to the right or far right in recent months.
